name: Protein Gatte Curry
ingredients: ½ cup plain low-fat Greek yogurt
Ajwain, turmeric, chilli and ½ tsp oil
steps: Mix besan, tofu and spices into firm dough.
Shape into rolls and boil until cooked.
Whisk yogurt with water and spices; simmer gatte gently.
note: Use plain unsweetened yogurt; this is a protein-enhanced regional adaptation.
